tagline: A calm, hospital-adjacent Asian side neighbourhood — well-served by amenities, home to a large expat medical community, and conveniently located.

items.name: Acıbadem Caddesi Kafeler
items.description: Several cafés along the main avenue catering to the local professional and medical community. Practical and pleasant.

items.name: Acıbadem Restoranları
items.description: A good range of restaurants on the main avenue and side streets. Very local crowd, good prices.

tips: Acıbadem is well-served by bus from Üsküdar and Kadıköy.
Home to Acıbadem Hospital — many medical professionals live in the area.
A practical residential neighbourhood without strong tourist interest.
Üsküdar (15 min by bus) is the best nearby area for sightseeing and dining.
